title: Correlation of morphology and functionality in traumatic lesions of peripheral nerves
summary: Patients with traumatic lesions of peripheral nerves will be included in this study. During operation, an ultrasound as well as an neurophysiologic examination of the injured nerve will be performed. These two kind of examinations will be compared with regard to improvement of the preoperative neurological deficits.
conditions: Traumatic peripheral nerve lesions in continuity

interventions.name: Patients with traumatic lesions of peripheral nerves will be included in the study. During operation, an ultrasonic as well as an neurophysiological examination of the injured nerve will be performed. Both investigations will be compared regarding the correlation related to the neurological outcome.

criteria:
